pageTitle: "Burgeoning Grace" Yaoyao Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise~
name: "Burgeoning Grace" Yaoyao Is Here! Participate in the Event to Win Merchandise~
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Today, we will be introducing a disciple of Streetward Rambler - Yaoyao! In the eyes of the people of Liyue Harbor, Madame Ping always brings the smiley Yaoyao along with her, and the two behave like a loving grandparent with her grandchild. In truth, Yaoyao is Madame Ping's — or should we say Streetward Rambler's — disciple. Yaoyao is a warmhearted and considerate child, and the adepti are all very fond of her. Although she is still very young, she will in time become a most knowledgeable girl. Traveler, do you have topics that you want to discuss with Yaoyao?
